note: External job-performer roles in customer workflows. NOT internal org roles (see CONSTELLATION). These are the people whose work TERRAIN maps before any solution exists.

actors.responsibility: Procure, finance, and accept energy retrofits; verify that contracted performance outcomes are delivered before releasing final payment.
actors.context: Post-retrofit measurement-and-verification (M&V) period, typically 1–3 years after installation.
actors.authority: Approves or withholds final performance-based payment to contractor.
actors.note: Organization types include building management companies, municipalities, housing associations, hospitals, universities.

actors.organizationType: Energy Service Company or specialist retrofit contractor
actors.responsibility: Design, install, and guarantee energy performance of retrofit measures; provide measurement data to demonstrate performance.
actors.context: Post-installation phase when invoicing building owner for performance-based milestone payments.
actors.authority: Issues performance reports and payment claims to building owner.
actors.note: May be Energy Service Companies (ESCOs) operating under Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs), or general contractors operating under simpler payment-for-outcome terms.

actors.organizationType: Third-party engineering consultancy or certified auditor
actors.responsibility: Independently verify energy savings claimed by contractor using agreed measurement methodology; produce M&V report.
actors.context: Engaged when contractor and building owner cannot agree on baseline or savings calculation.
actors.authority: Issues binding or advisory verification report.
actors.note: Often engaged under IPMVP (International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol). Cost: typically EUR 5,000–50,000 per engagement.

actors.role: Energy Manager / Flexibility Coordinator at Industrial Site
actors.organizationType: Energy-intensive industrial manufacturer (steel, cement, chemicals, paper, etc.)
actors.responsibility: Enrol site in grid flexibility programs; respond to flexibility events by curtailing or shifting load; document and claim performance-based payments from aggregator or grid operator.
actors.context: During and immediately after a called flexibility event. Also during monthly/quarterly settlement reconciliation.
actors.authority: Controls site load-shedding equipment. Submits performance data to aggregator.
actors.note: This role exists at most large industrial facilities participating in Demand Response, Balancing Mechanism, or capacity market programs.

actors.role: Flexibility Aggregator / Virtual Power Plant Operator
actors.organizationType: Specialized energy aggregation company or utility subsidiary
actors.responsibility: Aggregate flexibility from multiple industrial and commercial sites; submit combined bids to grid operator; distribute settlement payments to participants; reconcile individual site performance.
actors.context: Post-event settlement period, typically D+1 to D+30.
actors.authority: Issues settlement payments. Applies performance haircuts for under-delivery.

actors.organizationType: B2B buyer organization (any sector with high-stakes vendor selection)
actors.responsibility: Evaluate vendor claims, collect evidence of product performance and certifications, make or recommend purchase decisions, manage vendor risk.
actors.context: During vendor evaluation and qualification phase. Also during contract compliance monitoring post-purchase.
actors.authority: Approves or rejects vendor shortlisting; signs or recommends purchase orders.
actors.note: Most relevant for complex capital equipment, software, certified materials, or regulated products where vendor claims carry financial or compliance risk.
